Before you can obtain your international clearance and complete registration, you must first obtain fees clearance. Here's how:

1. Complete the Online Fee Estimator on the Student Self Service Portal to calculate your annual tuition fees, related costs, and on-campus accommodation fees (if applicable).
2. Pay 75% of your annual tuition fee on or before registration. Banking details are provided on the Fees Estimate. Any outstanding fees from previous years must be settled first.
3. Email your proof of payment and a copy of the Fees Estimate to Jabu.Bodibe@wits.ac.za or mark.cryer@wits.ac.za (mark.crier@wits.ac.za).

Outstanding fees from previous years must be settled before registration.

Once fees clearance is confirmed, you can proceed to ISO for your international clearance. 

Contact Us
